info.name: GIG Backend API
info.description:
All /api/v1 endpoints of gig-backend.

Setup: set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:4000/api/v1). Run Auth > Login (or Register then OTP Verify); the access and refresh tokens are saved to collection variables automatically. List requests save the first item id (companyId, issuerId, ...) so detail requests work right after.

Admin requests need a user with a staff role (ADMIN, MODERATOR, ...). Prive-only requests need a KYC-approved Prive user.

request.description: Sends two OTPs (email + phone; codes appear in the server log). Then run "Signup verify EMAIL" and "Signup verify PHONE". The second one returns the tokens.

exec: try { const x = d.challenges.find((c) => c.channel === 'EMAIL').challengeId; if (x) pm.collectionVariables.set('emailChallengeId', x); } catch (e) {}
try { const x = d.challenges.find((c) => c.channel === 'PHONE').challengeId; if (x) pm.collectionVariables.set('phoneChallengeId', x); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Set emailOtp to the EMAIL code from the server log. Returns PENDING until both codes are verified.

exec: try { const x = d.tokens.accessToken; if (x) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', x); } catch (e) {}
try { const x = d.tokens.refreshToken; if (x) pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', x); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Set phoneOtp to the PHONE code from the server log. Returns COMPLETED with tokens.

exec: try { const x = d.tokens.accessToken; if (x) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', x); } catch (e) {}
try { const x = d.tokens.refreshToken; if (x) pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', x); } catch (e) {}

request.description: All fields optional. Also: otherJob, avatarFileId (from Files > Upload URL with purpose AVATAR).
Use codes from Lookups. focus/risk exactly 1, style/sector 1-3.
OBSERVER | PRIVE | INSTITUTIONAL
